messages:
zoe (CSM): VerdantAI ops request: 48h marketing promo in ap-south. Need temporary QPS increase + header allowlist for partner 'payflow.partner.co'. Can infra support scoped bump + auto-revoke?
vik (SRE): What QPS and exact header?
zoe (CSM): 3x baseline, hard cap 450 RPS. Header: `X-PF-Signature`. Start 2026-06-02 03:00 UTC, duration 48h. Scope: ap-south only, no cross-region spill.
maya (Support): Account note: renewal in 4 weeks; success here could affect renewal. No open incidents. Recommend low-friction path.
omar (AE): I'll confirm billing/credit — they asked for a small promo credit but can sign PO if needed.
vik (SRE): Plan: add customer-scoped ingress rule in ap-south with header+host match and optional partner CIDRs. qps_override=450, expires_at=2026-06-04T03:00:00Z, auto-revoke true. Need CR and short review.
infra-bot: Created CR-4210 for verdantai header allowlist + qps override. Review ETA 60m.
maya (Support): I'll send the ops note to VerdantAI with example curl and dashboard links. Include rollback contact.
vik (SRE): Rollout: staging smoke tonight, prod apply 20m before start, canary 10m then full. Rollback: remove rule, reset qps, flush routing caches.
zoe (CSM): Thanks team. @omar ping when billing is confirmed and we'll greenlight. :white_check_mark:
